title: Round and Round She Goes
summary: Have you ever taken a sightseeing or a whale watching cruise? If so, did your boat do what mine did when the key sights came into view? I remember taking the Circle Line around Manhattan on a school field trip, with everyone rushing to one side when the Statue of Liberty came into view, then rushing to the other as we circled Liberty Island, ostensibly to avoid passengers needing to switch sides. That behavior is afoot in stocks, as we careened into tech in September and away from it this week.
